blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Oriental Mindoro provincial government has recommended a price range of P180 to P192 per kilogram for live hogs as it seeks to provide a reference for transactions among hog raisers, traders and other industry stakeholders.
